text:
kevin: heads up — nightly image hardening pipeline failed verification on the staging canary, cosign returned 'key mismatch' for signed base image
sec-bot: [ALERT] image verification failed: public key fingerprint mismatch (expected f4:2b:..., got c3:9d:...)
lina: that fingerprint is from the new KMS signing key we rotated this morning as part of the quarterly rotation
anna: did we update the signer daemon's configured key alias? i thought the rotation was supposed to be transparently aliased
kevin: checked the signer logs, it served signatures using new key but the image registry still has metadata referencing the old key id
ryan: looks like terraform rotation flow didn't update the registry metadata because the finalizer step errored with 403 (permission denied)
sec-bot: audit snippet: KMS IAM change at 05:12Z removed roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier from svc-image-reg@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com, then keyversion setPrimary v3 at 05:14Z
kevin: removing verifier role explains why the registry couldn't patch image attestation refs
anna: oncall, can we pause the canary rollout until we confirm metadata alignment?
oncall: pausing non-critical canaries for 45m. creating incident INC-4120
compliance: tagging — we need extended KMS audit retention and to snapshot the signer config for evidence
lina: i'm going to re-add verifier role in IAM, but per policy this needs two approvers for prod. can we do an expedited rollback as a temporary measure?
ryan: PR opened to revert IAM change. @lina and @kevin please approve for emergency revert
kevin: approved. lina, you have the green to apply once second approval is in
sec-bot: PR comment: auto-scan detected terraform plan will add roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier back to svc-image-reg (approved by kevin)
anna: while we wait, can someone re-run the attestation verification locally? command: `cosign verify-attestation --key k8s://projects/redwood-kms/... gcr.io/redwood/canary:staging-20260323`
lina: ran verify-attestation -> failure: attestation claims key id old-v2, signature present but key lookup returned 'not found'
kevin: that's consistent — registry has old metadata, signer already on v3. two paths: 1) update registry metadata to point to v3 (requires verifier IAM) 2) re-sign images with old key (bad practice)
anna: prefer 1. re-signing defeats attestation chain
ryan: after IAM revert, we should run a small migration job: scan images with v2 refs and update them to v3 using a signed, auditable script; run in staging then prod
oncall: migration job needs changelog + runbook; will block until runbook exists
compliance: also note CVE-2026-2002 (openssl) popped in SBOM for one baseimage. please don't trigger a full rebuild during this incident unless necessary
kevin: agreed. isolate the KMS/attestation issue from unrelated rebuilds
lina: applied IAM revert. monitoring KMS audit logs...
sec-bot: KMS audit: 05:27Z permission restored, subsequent calls from svc-image-reg returned OK
lina: re-running the registry metadata update job now (dry-run first)
anna: dry-run indicates 12 images will be migrated. please capture SHAs. command used: `./scripts/update-attestation-refs --dry-run --prefix gcr.io/redwood/ --from v2 --to v3`
kevin: dry-run output: 12 images, earliest created 2026-03-18, none are production tagged (only staging/canary). good to proceed after one more check
ryan: executing migration job with lock and monitoring. ETA ~8m
kevin: migration finished. re-run cosign verify on staging canary -> PASS
anna: excellent. document everything in INC-4120 and attach KMS audit logs + terraform diff + migration script output
compliance: filing evidence bundle and extending KMS audit retention window to 90 days for the incident scope
sec-bot: incident INC-4120 -> status: mitigated (rollback + metadata migration). recommended actions: add terraform guardrail to block removal of signerVerifier role, add pre-rotation validator to ensure signer config alias exists, add CI test for attestation metadata drift
lina: i will own the terraform guardrail PR (ETA EOD). ryan will own the pre-rotation validator (ETA next week).
kevin: next steps on image hardening: schedule a controlled baseimage rebuild for the openssl CVE (CVE-2026-2002) after rotations are stabilized; link RBAC change window to rebuild schedule to avoid cross-change noise
ryan: opening a coordination ticket in #eng-runtime to align rebuild window with next maintenance slot
kevin: thanks all. closing incident once compliance confirms evidence bundle uploaded
compliance: evidence bundle uploaded to INC-4120. leaving notes for postmortem and a follow-up meeting next Tue
sec-bot: INC-4120 -> closed (monitoring for 24h).
